crime_scene.title: The Last Party
crime_scene.narration: Last night, Maya Reyes and Sara Malik celebrated on this rooftop—their startup was funded, and they were flying out by morning. Daniel Reed was Maya's secret boyfriend. He was upset when he learned she was leaving. That night, no one knew it would be his last. Let's investigate the crime scene.

rooftop_investigation.title: Morning Return - Three Clues
rooftop_investigation.guide_text: It's time to find the evidence and catch the real person behind it.

cctv_landing.title: CCTV — Rooftop Feed
cctv_landing.narration: This is the CCTV we pulled from the building. Let's check it — the party, the argument, Maya and Sara leaving, Daniel left behind. Watch for anyone else on the roof. Time to talk to our main suspects: Sara, Maya, and Cole.

questions.cole_asks: Why were you and Maya celebrating that night?
questions.canon_hint: Maya and I are business partners. Our funding came through, and we were flying out the next morning. The party was supposed to be our last night before the trip, and Daniel did not know yet.

questions.cole_asks: CCTV shows Maya and Daniel arguing like a couple. Were they together?
questions.canon_hint: Yes. Maya was Daniel’s girlfriend. She kept it quiet because the business trip was already tense, and she was afraid the relationship would make everything look like betrayal.

evidence_reactions.couple_reveal: They were together. Maya was scared people would only see the fight and blame her.
evidence_reactions.audio_recorder: Daniel took her recorder. That is why she panicked.
evidence_reactions.memory_card: If that card has the audio, listen to it before blaming Maya.
evidence_reactions.camera_panel: Cole was security. He could make the camera lie.

questions.canon_hint: Yes. We were together, and I was going to tell him after the party that Sara and I had to travel the next morning. Then he played the recording he made about Cole — and the fight turned ugly.

questions.cole_asks: What was on the phone Daniel took?
questions.canon_hint: Audio. Daniel found gaps in the camera logs and realized Cole was keeping doctored footage to blackmail people in the building. I recorded Daniel explaining it — for proof, not because I wanted him dead.

evidence_reactions.audio_recorder: Daniel tore the recorder out of my hand when I grabbed for it.
evidence_reactions.memory_card: That card is the only reason you can hear what really happened.
evidence_reactions.camera_panel: Cole controlled the building cameras. Daniel knew that.
evidence_reactions.unknown_man: That was Cole. He was watching us before the camera glitched.

questions.cole_asks: Your credential triggered the blackout. Why?
questions.canon_hint: My credential appears in logs all over that building. That proves a system action, not murder. Someone could have used the panel while I was dealing with calls outside.

questions.cole_asks: The SD card has Daniel saying your name. What was he accusing you of?
questions.canon_hint: Daniel was drunk and scared. He thought he could ruin me with a story about missing footage. You still do not have video of me pushing him.

evidence_reactions.camera_panel: Logs can be misleading. You know that.
evidence_reactions.unknown_man: Security staff watching a rooftop party is not suspicious.
evidence_reactions.memory_card: Audio can be cut. Context matters.
evidence_reactions.couple_reveal: A jealous girlfriend gives you motive before it gives me one.

audio_reconstruction.title: Evidence Whiteboard

fragments.label: MAYA + DANIEL
fragments.speaker: MAYA
fragments.text: Daniel, listen to me. I was going to tell you after the party. Sara and I leave tomorrow because the partnership finally got funded, not because I stopped loving you.

fragments.label: SARA PULLS AWAY
fragments.speaker: SARA
fragments.text: Maya, come on. We have the morning flight. Leave the phone and walk away from Daniel before this ruins everything.

fragments.label: UNKNOWN VOICE
fragments.speaker: ADRIAN COLE
fragments.text: Daniel, the roof camera is unstable. Give me Maya's phone and that backup before your blackmail story gets louder.

fragments.label: CAMERA FEED CUT
fragments.speaker: DANIEL
fragments.text: Cole, why are you killing the feed? Maya already has the audio. You cannot erase both copies.

audio_reconstruction.resolution: Maya and Sara left Daniel alive. Cole stayed, cut the feed, and killed the one person who could prove he blackmailed tenants with hidden footage.

case_decision.title: Name the Killer

question.text: You have a girlfriend who hid a trip, a business partner who pulled her away, and a broken camera. Choose carefully, detective.

accuse_sara.label: Accuse Sara / torn coat at railing / she lied about contact

accuse_maya.label: Accuse Maya / stolen recording / she lied about the roof

accuse_cole.label: Accuse Cole / camera override and recovered audio / identify the killer

case_decision.decision_prompt: You are the detective. Who pushed Daniel Reed?

ending_accuse_sara.title: THE WRONG THREAD

question.text: I lied about touching him. I did not push him.

ending_accuse_sara.narration: You accuse Sara. You found the lie, not the murder. She protected Maya, pulled her away, and left Daniel alive. Cole walks.

ending_accuse_maya.title: THE WRONG MOTIVE

question.text: I chased my phone. Cole chased the evidence.

ending_accuse_maya.narration: You accuse Maya. The relationship made her look guilty, but the recovered audio clears the timeline. She lost Daniel twice, and Cole walks.

ending_killer_revealed.title: WHAT REALLY HAPPENED

question.text: You cannot prove what happened after the camera went dark.

ending_killer_revealed.narration: Yes. Cole blackmailed people with doctored building footage. Daniel found out, and Cole cut the feed and pushed him off the roof to bury the proof.
